title: OpenClaw for Teams: Run a Shared Multi-Agent Workspace Without Docker Chaos
summary: Run openclaw for teams without the Docker chaos: shared agents, per-user Telegram access, department AI workflows, and 24/7 uptime for your whole team.
body_markdown: Shared agent architecture (one instance, five users): from about $45/month per agent + model usage (billed from credits). Individual agents for each person: five agents, each billed separately. Department setup with three agents: three agents, each billed separately. Compare that to five VPS instances at $10-20/mo each plus five separate LLM API bills averaging $30-50/mo per person at moderate usage — the self-hosted path typically runs $200-350/mo for the same team. On Blink Claw, model usage is billed from your workspace credits, so there are no separate API keys or provider accounts.
